items.source: Set the AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler to use to handle uncaught exceptions thrown by asynchronous method executions.
items.translation: 设置要用于处理异步方法执行中抛出的未捕获异常的 AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler。

items.source: The TaskExecutor responsible for the asynchronous execution may be provided as well as the annotation type that indicates a method should be invoked asynchronously. If no annotation type is specified, this post- processor will detect both Spring's @Async annotation as well as the EJB 3.1 jakarta.ejb.Asynchronous annotation.
items.translation: 负责异步执行的TaskExecutor以及指示方法应被异步调用的注解类型也可以提供。如果未指定注解类型，此后置处理器将检测 Spring 的@Async注解以及 EJB 3.1 的jakarta.ejb.Asynchronous注解。

items.source: If not specified, default executor resolution will apply: searching for a unique TaskExecutor bean in the context, or for an Executor bean named "taskExecutor" otherwise. If neither of the two is resolvable, a local default executor will be created within the interceptor.
items.translation: 如果未指定，将应用默认的执行器解析：在上下文中搜索唯一的TaskExecutorBean，或者（否则）搜索名为 "taskExecutor" 的ExecutorBean。如果这两种方式都无法解析，则将在拦截器内创建一个本地默认执行器。

items.source: For methods having a void return type, any exception thrown during the asynchronous method invocation cannot be accessed by the caller. An AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler can be specified to handle these cases.
items.translation: 对于返回类型为 `void` 的方法，在异步方法调用期间抛出的任何异常都无法被调用者访问。可以指定一个 AsyncUncaughtExceptionHandler 来处理这些情况。

items.source:
Note: The underlying async advisor applies before existing advisors by default,
in order to switch to async execution as early as possible in the invocation chain.
items.translation: 注意：底层异步顾问默认在现有顾问之前应用，以便在调用链中尽早切换到异步执行。

items.source:
This setter property exists so that developers can provide their own
(non-Spring-specific) annotation type to indicate that a method (or all
methods of a given class) should be invoked asynchronously.
items.translation: 此 Setter 属性存在，以便开发人员提供自己的（非 Spring 特定的）注解类型，以指示应异步调用某个方法（或给定类的所有方法）。

items.source:
Configure this post-processor with the given executor and exception handler suppliers,
applying the corresponding default if a supplier is not resolvable.
items.translation: 配置此后置处理器，使用给定的执行器和异常处理程序供应商；如果无法解析某个供应商，则应用相应的默认值。

Note that the initial lookup happens by type; this is just the fallback
in case of multiple executor beans found in the context.
items.translation: 注意，初始查找是按类型进行的；这只是在上下文中找到多个执行器 Bean 时的后备方案。

items.translation: 默认要拾取的 `TaskExecutor` bean 的名称为："taskExecutor"。

items.source: Set the Executor to use when invoking methods asynchronously.
items.translation: 设置异步调用方法时使用的Executor。

items.source:

level.
items.translation: 将 `'async'` 注解类型设置为在类或方法级别进行检测。
